# Topped up

Adding the credit needs JavaScript: the balance lives in your browser.

This is the page the payment returns to. It adds the top-up to the balance kept in this browser, once per payment reference, and it does not, and cannot, verify the payment. [Why that is accepted](../meter/security.md).
